 KEY TAKEAWAYS:
 CSK are yet to announce their retained and released players for IPL 2027, with the deadline set for November 17, 2026.
 Ruturaj Gaikwad will lead a squad featuring Sanju Samson, MS Dhoni, Shivam Dube and Dewald Brevis.
 The IPL 2027 mini-auction is reportedly scheduled for December 16 in Goa.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement When will CSK announce their retained players list for IPL 2027?
 The Chennai Super Kings will officially reveal the names of the players they plan to retain and release ahead of the IPL 2027 mini-auction on November 17, 2026, the retention deadline.
 The five-time winners, along with the other 10 franchises, will reveal their retention list on that day. The final announcement will indicate who will continue playing for CSK next year and who will be on the auction list.
 MORE:  IPL 2027 trade tracker: Complete list of all player and cash deals before the IPL 2027 mini-auction 
 CSK retained players list for IPL 2027 mini-auction
 The final CSK retention list for IPL 2027 is yet to be announced. While the future of MS Dhoni still hangs in the balance, it is believed that the Chennai Super Kings would retain most of their team members before the mini-auction for IPL 2027.

 CSK released players ahead of IPL 2027 mini-auction
 Chennai Super Kings could be set to make some alterations to their squad following the 2026 season, as Rahul Chahar, Matt Henry, and Matthew Short have been named among those who will be axed from the team. The franchise has not announced its list yet.

 CSK's remaining purse for IPL 2027 mini-auction
 Chennai Super Kings (CSK) finished the IPL 2026 auction with ₹2.40 crore remaining in their purse. Following their four-player trade with Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH), the franchise has an additional net salary commitment of ₹2.20 crore.

 When is the IPL 2027 mini-auction?
 The IPL 2027 mini-auction is reportedly set to happen on 16 December 2026 in Goa.
 The deadline of retention has been notified as November 17. The auction will be a one-day mini-auction and the last in the current auction cycle before the mega auction for IPL 2028.
